                                     Table "public.people"
 Column |            Type             | Collation | Nullable |             Default              
--------+-----------------------------+-----------+----------+----------------------------------
 id     | integer                     |           | not null | generated by default as identity
 name   | character varying(50)       |           | not null | 'nobody'::character varying
 note   | text                        |           |          | 
 price  | numeric(10,2)               |           |          | 0
 flag   | boolean                     |           |          | true
 born   | date                        |           |          | 
 seen   | timestamp without time zone |           |          | CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 uid    | uuid                        |           |          | 
 order  | character varying(16)       |           |          | 
Indexes:
    "people_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id)
    "people_uid_key" UNIQUE CONSTRAINT, btree (uid)
